notes:
Account background:
- Mid-size retail-analytics SaaS selling personalization + conversational support to grocers and pharmacies. Heavy on transaction-sensitive PII and regional residency requirements.
- Eng org ~1200, ML team (10) + infra (6). procurement + security on 3-week cadence.
Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-07-14: inbound interest from Head of Product (use-case: chat + structured invoice extraction). Intro call w/ Priya.
- 2025-08-06: demo (hosted API flow) w/ SE (Liam) — team liked latency & API ergonomics.
- 2025-11-01: POC kickoff (2-week dataset, 3 endpoints: chat, extractor, reranker). Fireflies ff_2025-11-03_Arcadia_Rd1.
- 2025-11-15 to 2025-12-10: POC run; Redwood models initially matched baseline on casual chat but fell behind on structured-output recall and tool-calling reliability. SE and Arcadia data scientist logged regressions.

Why stalled / closed-lost details:
- Primary reason: observed quality regression vs incumbent on two critical metrics: structured extraction F1 (-8 pts vs baseline) and tool-calling failure rate (~12% calls failed to return correct schema). Team quote: "We can't ship if the extractor breaks downstream billing."
- Secondary: no clear internal champion after Head of ML changed scope; procurement deprioritized AI spend in Q1 (budget freeze).
- Security: outstanding ask for HSM/KMS proof and audit-log retention format; current docs didn't match Arcadia's compliance template.
POC findings (technical):
- Structured-output: Redwood's model returned near-valid JSON but often omitted required fields under long contexts; competitor handled truncation and schema enforcement better.
- Tool-calling: callback reliability degraded when prompt chaining exceeded 3 calls; led to incomplete external API invocations in our integration tests.
- Latency: meets SLO for median but tail latency spikes on larger sequences; Arcadia flagged tail due to downstream sync jobs.
- Cost sensitivity: Arcadia expects committed pricing; model fallback routing needs explicit behavior when quantized variants degrade quality.
Sales/ops notes / fragments:
- "lost to CloudGenAI on quality around structured outputs" — product lead (paraphrase).
- Next: propose narrow 'quality remediation' POC focusing only on structured extractor + tool-calling with real arcadia examples; offer short SLA on regressions + joint eval notebook.
- Blocker list for re-engage: resource to own internal project (champion), written KMS/HSM attestation, patch to JSON schema enforcement.
